units.summary: A new test checks that CompactSelectedSeries lowers Head.numStaleSeries only when it evicts a stale series. Evicting a non-stale series must leave the counter alone. It is test-only code and adds coverage without changing production behaviour.
units.headline: New test: stale counter tracks selected-series eviction correctly
units.reason: New test only; it cannot affect production behaviour.

units.summary: StaleHead is renamed to SelectedSeriesHead and its field becomes selectedSeriesRefs of the renamed seriesRefs type. The type is now a general view that both stale and selected-series compaction use. Nothing still refers to the old name.
units.headline: StaleHead renamed to SelectedSeriesHead with a generic refs field
units.reason: Rename that keeps the same shape; this unexported-use type is never serialized, and all uses are updated.

units.summary: The constructor is renamed from NewStaleHead and takes the generic seriesRefs type. Its body is unchanged.
units.headline: NewStaleHead renamed to NewSelectedSeriesHead
units.reason: Pure rename of the constructor; it builds the same struct and every caller is updated.

units.summary: Index now calls the renamed selectedSeriesIndex on the head instead of staleIndex, with the same arguments.
units.headline: Index delegates to the renamed selectedSeriesIndex
units.reason: Same call, now made through renamed helpers.

units.summary: NumSeries used to return the head-wide stale count. It now returns how many refs the view selected. That number feeds only Meta().Stats.NumSeries of the in-memory view, which compactor.Write does not read for its decisions, so the result is more accurate and low-risk.
units.headline: NumSeries returns the selected ref count, not the head stale count
units.reason: Small semantic change to a view's stats value, which compaction does not use for decisions.

units.summary: The placeholder ULID for the view changes from STALEHEAD to SELECTEDSERIES. oklog/ulid's non-strict Parse does not check for invalid characters such as I and L, so MustParse will not panic. The ULID is never persisted: compactor.Write generates new ULIDs for the blocks it writes.
units.headline: Placeholder head ULID renamed to SELECTEDSERIES
units.reason: Identifier for an in-memory view only; non-strict parsing accepts it.

units.summary: Meta now uses the renamed ULID variable on the renamed receiver. Its logic is unchanged.
units.headline: Meta uses the renamed selectedSeriesHeadULID
units.reason: Renamed receiver and ULID; same structure.

units.summary: The string shown in logs and errors changes from "stale head" to "selected-series head", and a typo in the comment is fixed.
units.headline: String output now reads "selected-series head"
units.reason: Only the text shown in logs and errors changes.
